about: Splicing track SP-2 (docs/phases/splicing-track.md; logic/genes.js). A Gene is a slot's part taken from a donor's kit recipe (kitBuilds.json): Billy.graft is { slot: donor rig }. kinds: the trait each part kind (partKits.json parts.kind) brings; traits: what a trait does, as effect rows on the Billie that wears it (logic/effects.js fxOfBillie); parts: a part's dominant type (it becomes the second type) and, from SP-4, the move it teaches; stability: what a foreign part costs and the limit; unstable: a splice past the limit. Every trait, number and dominant type is a PLACEHOLDER until the owner sets them (the track's Ask me before).

airborne.name: Airborne
airborne.d: Takes half damage from Ground moves.
